action_summary: Round 13 attacked the only unbuilt bucket of the round-12 census (40.3% new code) by asking the question underneath it: what does 'learned permanently' mean when the verifier that defines success accepts more than one implementation? The tree's own repair aimer was measured on the unsolved set at 13 of 46, so synthesis exists; every round discarded all but the first passing repair. Keeping the whole set changes the question. On 17 real fix commits the machinery can build a repair on 1 and refuses by name on 16. On that one -- pypa/packaging 022ae6c6 -- the commit's own 344 tests accept FOUR distinct repairs at FOUR different guards with four different error messages, one of which is the human's. The verifier is exact about behaviour and silent about intent, so permanence is well defined for behaviour and undefined for intent. The constructive half is mechanical: group the passing repairs by the message their guard emits and the version space becomes one question a non-technical user can answer ('what should C:LICENSE's error say?'), with no model and no network. The 40.3% feature bucket stays out and the reason is now stated rather than implied: __replace__ is forty lines of design that a one-sentence request and a behavioural test do not determine.

agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: REUSE succeeded almost entirely, and research exhaustion came first this time because the tree already had the theory under non-obvious names: `canonical/runtime/finite_identifiability.py` (version-space filtering, equivalence classes, minimax discriminator, explicit non-identifiability), `epistemic_closure_kernel_v1.py` (decide only when all survivors agree), `demonstration_version_space_v1.py` (GUI readings), `identification_cost_in_a_real_space_v1.py` (median 1037 survivors on real bugs), `repair_version_space_selection_v1.py` (selection versus synthesis). What was missing was the bridge from a real action in a real environment to that kernel, and the decision it enables. The kernel is imported unchanged; the new object is the grammar over the state and the three-way verdict.

obs_blocker.intrinsic_or_path_specific: intrinsic: what a set of observations determines is a fact about the action and the observations, not about the learner. Either the survivors agree on the states in reach or they do not.
obs_blocker.surviving_causal_blocker: One execution leaves a set of readings that agree on the observed state. For real actions that set is larger than one (343 readings in the grammar here, median 1037 candidate programs in the tree's coding measurement), and the readings part company only on states the observation never touched -- which is why the failure is invisible exactly where it happens.

obs_solution.efficiency_mechanism: Discovery costs one subprocess per (step, candidate path) and buys the difference between redoing 8 steps and redoing 14, or worse, redoing 1 wrong step and declaring the work repaired.
obs_solution.generality_mechanism: The rule is not about tar: any step is a function of the state it can see, so perturbing a candidate and comparing the consequence yields its read set on a GUI, a database or a network service with the matching probe.
obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Reading the read set off argv is wrong in both directions and fails 2 of 3 real chains; tracing requires infrastructure that does not exist here and annotates what must be discovered; asking a model is prohibited producer cognition; redoing everything works and costs 75% more, and does not tell the agent what to redo when the state is too large to rebuild.

read the read set off the command line

ask a model which steps to redo
obs_solution.white_box_harvest_note: The canonical ladder was applied in order; WHITE_BOX_HARVEST was considered and found empty. No donor model, weight or external artifact was used: the rule is a counterfactual on the tree's own action environment.

obs_verification.synthetic_verification_necessity: No synthetic case decides anything: every observation is a real subprocess on a real copy of a real state, and the refusal is produced by a real `sort -R` contradicting its own first execution.
